subject.title: fix(macos): defer cookie import banner until inline browser opens

question: Is the inability to capture the signed macOS flow acceptable as a proof override, or must native after-fix behavior evidence be supplied before merge?
rationale: The patch and automated validation are strong, but repository policy treats real behavior proof as a merge gate for this external user-visible native-app change, and the PR carries a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Require native proof
options.body: Keep the PR in human review until a redacted recording, runtime trace, or live output shows quiet launch/auth and the first eligible inline-browser banner.

options.title: Override the proof gate
options.body: Explicitly accept the signed-build, regression, and CI evidence as sufficient for this narrowly scoped timing change.

recommendation.title: Require native proof
recommendation.body: Keep the PR in human review until a redacted recording, runtime trace, or live output shows quiet launch/auth and the first eligible inline-browser banner.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest routing signal is the merged feature history for the inline banner and its macOS dashboard integration.
